abstract.en: A reproducible Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline for recoding free-text descriptions of economic activities into the NACE 2.1 nomenclature, running end-to-end on SSPCloud (Qdrant vector database, llm.lab gateway, S3 / MinIO). Inspired by subject 2 of the 2026 AIML4OS funathon.
